Metadata.title: Domo — shared household management
Metadata.description: Organize your household's pantry and shopping list together, with a status per item. Free app by Café Labs, available on the web and Android.

Hero.title: The whole house knows what's in the pantry.
Hero.description: Every item marked <tem>Have it</tem>, <falta>Missing</falta>, or <carrinho>In cart</carrinho> — no duplicating everything in a group chat or a separate spreadsheet.

HowItWorks.title: The way your household actually uses it
HowItWorks.step1Body: Every item in the house marked Have it, Missing, or In cart — one tap in the app is all it takes to keep the pantry current.
HowItWorks.step2Body: The shopping list is born straight from the pantry: anything not marked Have it already shows up ready to buy, no need to add it again somewhere else.
HowItWorks.step3Body: Invite whoever lives with you with a 6-character code and manage members and roles — the pantry becomes the whole house's, not just yours.

Demo.title: Rearrange the shelf
Demo.description: Tap a pantry item to switch its status and watch the shopping list update itself — the same way it works in the real app.
Demo.emptyShoppingList: Nothing missing — the list is empty.
Demo.hint: Tap to try it out — local preview, nothing is saved.

DeleteAccount.title: Delete your Domo account
DeleteAccount.metaDescription: How to delete your Domo account and the data stored in it — in the app or by email. You do not need to sign in to use this page.
DeleteAccount.developerValue: Café Labs, operated by Felipe Portes Antunes
DeleteAccount.intro: This page explains how to request deletion of your Domo account and the data stored in it. You do not need to sign in to use this page.
DeleteAccount.warnTitle: Before deleting: mind the houses you created
DeleteAccount.warnBody: Deletion is permanent and irreversible. If you created a house, it is deleted for every member, with all its items. Domo cannot yet transfer a house to another member; if you do not want the house to end, talk to the other members first. Domo also has no in-app export yet: if you want a copy of your data and your house first, ask by email (Option 2).
DeleteAccount.inAppStep1: Open Domo on your phone or at <app>app.domo.cafelabs.net</app> and sign in.
DeleteAccount.inAppStep4: Confirm with your password (or sign in with Google again). Deletion starts immediately and cannot be undone.
DeleteAccount.inAppFallback: Can't find this option in the app version you use? Use Option 2 below — it is equally valid.
DeleteAccount.emailTitle: Option 2 — by email, no app needed
DeleteAccount.emailBody: Write to <mail>privacidade@cafelabs.net</mail> from the email address registered on your account, asking for deletion. You do not need to give a reason.
DeleteAccount.emailBodyTemplate:
Hello,

I request deletion of my Domo account and the data stored in it.

Email registered on the account: 

Thank you.
DeleteAccount.emailDeadline: Requests are answered within 15 days, as required by the LGPD (Brazilian Law 13,709/2018).
DeleteAccount.emailIdentity: If you cannot write from the registered email, say in the message which one it is. We may need to confirm the account is yours before deleting — precisely to stop someone else from erasing your data.
DeleteAccount.deletedItem1: Your login account — email, password and, if you signed in with Google, the link to your Google account.
DeleteAccount.deletedItem2: Your member data (name and photo) in every house you belong to.
DeleteAccount.deletedItem3: Your pending requests to join houses.
DeleteAccount.deletedItem4: The record of your acceptance of the Terms and Policy.
DeleteAccount.deletedItem5: Houses you created, with all their items, for every member.
DeleteAccount.deletedOutro: None of this becomes a deactivated account that could be reopened later.
DeleteAccount.retainedItem1: Items in other people's houses: items you added to a house that is not yours stay, as they are that house's shared list. They keep no name, photo or email of yours; only an internal code remains, which does not identify you.
DeleteAccount.retainedItem2: Infrastructure backups: copies already made expire on the provider's (Google's) cycle and are not restored.
DeleteAccount.retainedOutro: Domo is not a financial institution and issues no tax documents; there is no legal duty to keep your notes, and the deletion request is honored in full.
DeleteAccount.contactBody: Privacy and personal data: <privacy>privacidade@cafelabs.net</privacy>. Other matters: <general>contato@cafelabs.net</general>.
DeleteAccount.contactPolicy: How your data is handled is described in full in the <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
